spans.s:
सौखशायनिक सौखशायनिक, अस्, m. (fr.
सुख-शयन), one who asks another whether he
has slept well; [cf. सौस्नातिक.]

सौखशायिक, अस्, m. (fr. सुख-शायिन्), = the
above.

सौखसुप्तिक सौखसुप्तिक, अस्, m. (fr. सुख-
सुप्ति), one who asks another whether he has slept
well; a bard or minstrel whose duty is to waken
kings in the morning with music and song.

सौख्य सौख्य, अम्, n. (fr. सुख), pleasure,
happiness, felicity, enjoyment.

सौखिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to pleasure, pleasur-
able, sensual, pleasure-seeking.

सौखीय, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to pleasure or
enjoyment.
